description: This file defines the 'MultiRegionAccessPointArn' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an Amazon S3 multi-region bucket ARN. It includes methods for parsing ARN strings and validating ARN data.

classes.name: MultiRegionAccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 multi-region access point ARN, extends 'AccessPointArn', provides static methods for parsing and validation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into an associative array of its components; delegates to parent parse method.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ARN data array; delegates to 'Aws\Arn\Arn::validate' method.
